tools.name: list_exams
tools.description: All exams on Quiz20 that have previous year question papers, with the number of papers and the link to each exam page.

tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: Previous year question papers of one exam (e.g. "BPSC CCE", "UPSC CSE", "UP PGT", "CDS"), newest first, with questions, time, and links to the paper page, the PDF (when available) and the online test.

tools.name: search_topics
tools.description: Search Quiz20 by topic name (e.g. "Mughal", "Budget", "Rivers", "Census", "Constitution"): matching topic-wise quizzes, NCERT chapter PDFs and GK practice sets, with links.

tools.name: list_practice_sets
tools.description: Free practice sets of 20 MCQs: General Knowledge, Computer, State special GK, Census 2011 and latest data-based questions, with their topics and links.
